answer: Agents trading warehouse receipts for velvet shipped along a river anchor settlement in atomic delivery-versus-payment. The contract transfers a registered receipt to the buyer only in the same transaction that transfers the agreed funds to its seller; otherwise both transfers revert. A swarm of seller aliases cannot collect payment while withholding title, nor sell a receipt it does not own. This removes unsecured counterparty exposure rather than counting identities, and relies on the warehouse honoring its receipts.
